verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's own docs say it ships mobile, desktop and web apps and that codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted, which delivers the core of multi-device sync. The evidence does not name tablets, does not say sync happens automatically or in the background, and offers no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit tablet support, documentation that sync is automatic or real-time, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-device sync.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Auth has an app for every platform. Mobile, desktop and web. Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
